title: Alumina Hydrate Filter
model_title: Rotary Vacuum Drum Filter for Alumina Hydrate

introduction.definition: A rotary vacuum drum filter separates alumina hydrate from liquor. The drum turns partly submerged in slurry; vacuum draws liquor through the cloth so a cake forms, is washed and dried, and is then released by air blow-back and a scraper.

pressure.title: Vacuum zones round the drum
pressure.description: Each drum sector passes through the slurry (cake formation under vacuum), then dewatering and washing zones, then a blow-back zone where the vacuum valve switches to air pressure to release the cake at the scraper. Vacuum is typically ~ 0.4–0.8 bar below atmospheric; cake moisture and wash efficiency set the soda carried to calcination.

video_tutorials.title: Alumina Hydrate Filter — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Alumina Hydrate Filter.
A rotary vacuum drum filter separates alumina hydrate from liquor.
The drum turns partly submerged in slurry; vacuum draws liquor through the cloth so a cake forms, is washed and dried, and is then released by air blow-back and a scraper.
Typical applications include product hydrate filtration; seed filtration.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Slurry Trough (drum submerged ~ 30–40 %), Drum with Internal Filtrate Pipes (rotates ~ 0.5–3 rpm), Filter Cloth Sector Strips (show drum rotation).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Alumina Hydrate Filter — Operation

script.narration: How the Alumina Hydrate Filter works.
The drum dips into slurry and a cake forms.
The cake is washed by sprays.
The vacuum valve switches zones.
The scraper discharges the cake.
The drive turns the drum.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

Each drum sector passes through the slurry (cake formation under vacuum), then dewatering and washing zones, then a blow-back zone where the vacuum valve switches to air pressure to release the cake at the scraper.

video_tutorials.title: Alumina Hydrate Filter — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Alumina Hydrate Filter.
Check cake, cloth and vacuum.
Wash cloth; check valve wear plate.
Replace cloth.
Watch for cloth blinding: wet cake, low rate. Common cause: scale, fines.
Watch for vacuum loss: thin cake. Common cause: valve wear, leaks.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
